mission: Bound OpenStreetMap Overpass discovery concurrency, pacing, retry and timeout behavior without inheriting stale donor-branch baggage.

scopeExtracted: src/discovery.mjs routing through the bounded policy

productionInvariant: Concurrent Overpass requests for one endpoint are serialized.
Minimum request spacing is bounded and configurable.
Only explicitly retryable HTTP statuses are retried.
Transport and retryable HTTP failures stop at a bounded attempt cap.
Retry-After is honored within a bounded ceiling.
Discovery parsing, public-source attribution and daily result caps remain unchanged.

focusedExecutionEvidence.commandClass: node --test exact committed overpass-throttle semantics copied from the branch

promotionGates: Refresh main and open PRs for concurrency immediately before promotion.
Obtain an exact-head Vercel READY build receipt for the candidate.
Execute focused discovery and Overpass tests from a genuine repository checkout/runtime when infrastructure permits.
Do not treat zero-step GitHub Actions jobs as source execution evidence.
